# ZIP with data descriptors

`sample1-data-descriptor.zip` is laid out the way streaming ZIP writers produce archives. Each entry is deflated and has the "data descriptor" flag (general purpose bit 3) set, so its CRC and sizes follow the compressed data rather than being in its local file header. It holds two entries, `first.txt` and `dir/second.txt`, with no extra fields.

It was generated by `python3 generate.py`, which writes the archive with Python's `zipfile` module to a stream that can't seek. The script checks the flag and compression method of every entry before saving, and its output is the same on every run.

The fixture is committed rather than built during the test because the SDK's `zip` dependency has no compression support compiled in, and enabling it for tests would also enable it for the SDK in test builds.
